benchmarkReuse.limitation: The five public-repository tasks had been exercised during earlier evaluator and product iterations, so this is disclosed benchmark reuse rather than a strictly unseen corpus. The final run uses fresh run nonces, fresh isolated sessions, a candidate frozen before current provider outcomes, no pooled earlier outcomes, and no task-specific product tuning. Pre-treatment packet corrections only made the shared Phase 1 regressions compatible with the historical accepted fixes.
